connector.name: WhatsApp MCP by adelaidasofia
connector.registryDescription: WhatsApp MCP. SQLCipher-encrypted, scrubber-CI-gated, draft-and-confirm sends, voice transcription.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package adelaidasofia-whatsapp-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the adelaidasofia account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: WHATSAPP_BRIDGE_HOST
env.description: Hostname for the Go bridge REST API.

env.name: WHATSAPP_BRIDGE_PORT
env.description: Port for the Go bridge REST API.

env.name: WHATSAPP_VAULT_CRM_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to a vault CRM folder for auto-injection (e.g., Obsidian 'CRM/'). When unset, CRM injection is disabled.

env.name: WHATSAPP_WHISPER_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key. Required only when WHATSAPP_WHISPER_BACKEND=openai-api.

env.name: WHATSAPP_WHISPER_MODEL
env.description: whisper.cpp model name. Only used when backend is local-cpp.

env.name: WHATSAPP_SCRUB_PROMPT_INJECTION
env.description: Strip known prompt-injection patterns from incoming messages before the LLM sees them.

env.name: WHATSAPP_AUDIT_LOG
env.description: Log every tool call to audit.log.

env.name: WHATSAPP_ENCRYPT_DB
env.description: Enable SQLCipher DB encryption with the key sourced from macOS Keychain.
